chapter_meta_description: Han Li faces a Core Formation elder with a powerful secret. In a masterclass of social engineering, he trades rare herbs for a pill formula without ever showing his hand.
og_title: RMJI 235: The Deal That Defines the Mortal Stream
og_description: No sword fights. No magic. Just two cultivators playing a flawless game of negotiation—and a quiet victory that changes everything.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch 235: Outsmarting a Core Formation Elder with Words
twitter_description: Han Li doesn't fight Lei Wanhe. He plays him. A masterclass in the "quiet victory" of negotiations and the brutal economy of the cultivation world.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-level pill designed to accelerate the cultivation speed of Core Formation cultivators, requiring ingredients over five hundred years old.
A provisional rank within a sect, granting lower privileges and less commitment from the master than a full personal disciple.
A cultivation plateau where a cultivator's progress is forcibly halted, often requiring external aid (pills, enlightenment, or rare resources) to overcome.
An underground or secretive auction house in the cultivation world, often dealing in rare and illicit goods.
The third major realm of cultivation in RMJI, representing a massive leap in power, lifespan, and resource requirements.
The second major realm of cultivation, marking a cultivator’s official entry into the upper echelons of the sect.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the author spend so much time on Lei Wanhe's internal thoughts?
cultural_notes_faq.a: To establish the brutal scarcity logic of the Core Formation bottleneck and to let the reader enjoy the irony of a powerful elder being completely outmaneuvered by a junior he dismisses.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Han Li lying about the thousand-year herb?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is telling a strategically crafted half-truth. The auction may be real, but the “regret” is a calculated performance to inflame Lei Wanhe’s greed and desperation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is a pill formula so valuable?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Mortal Stream, ancient alchemical knowledge has been systematically hoarded or lost. A single viable formula is a major strategic asset that can be used infinitely, unlike a pill which is consumed once.
